subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

Please ___________more sugar to the juice so that it becomes sweeter.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"add" **means to combine or join something to something else, which fits the context of the sentence where more sugar needs to be combined with the juice to make it sweeter.
 
• **"Ad" is short for advertisement and does not fit the context.**
 
• **"Aid" **means to help or assist, which is not relevant in this context.
 
• **"Aide"** refers to a person who helps or assists, which also does not fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Please** add **more sugar to the juice so that it becomes sweeter."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Add** means to combine or join something to something else, which makes sense in the context of making the juice sweeter.
 
• **Ad** is short for advertisement, which is not related to the context of the sentence.
 
• **Aid** means help or assistance, which is not relevant here.
 
• **Aide** refers to a person who helps or assists, which also does not fit the context.
